title: V01-C04 Algorithms, Pseudocode, and Tracing Production Packet

assessment_alignment.acceptance_evidence: A language-independent terminating fare algorithm with explicit preconditions and postconditions, two normal traces, one boundary trace, one invalid-input trace, and an evidence-based termination and AI-audit defense.

accessibility_requirements: Every diagram has an ordered text alternative.
Trace tables use descriptive headers and do not rely on color.
Animations have static, pause, and reduced-motion alternatives.
Turkish technical terms include English at first meaningful use.
Pseudocode uses consistent indentation and one operation per line.
Learner instructions have explicit deliverables and time boxes.
known_risks: Learners may copy programming-language syntax into pseudocode.
A few successful traces may be mistaken for proof of correctness.
Stop conditions may be written without guaranteed progress.
Preconditions may be used to hide required invalid-input behavior.
AI may invent rules or produce a non-terminating branch.
Student pilot is deferred by Repository Owner until later production.
